rows.text_en: Ministry of Finance and Economy ( Tax Law Enforcement Team ), 044-215-4154

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「세무사법」 및 동법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2005. 2. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Certified Tax Accountant Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
[Wholly Amended Aug. 30, 2000]

rows.source_ko: 제2조(세무사자격심의위원회의 회의) ①「세무사법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제3조의2제1항의 규정에 의한 세무사자격심의위원회는 회의를 개최한 때에는 의사록을 작성하여야 한다. <개정 2000. 2. 26., 2000. 8. 30., 2005. 2. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Meetings of the Certified Tax Accountant Qualification Screening Committee) ①The Certified Tax Accountant Qualification Screening Committee established pursuant to Article 3-2, Paragraph 1 of the Certified Tax Accountant Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall prepare minutes when it holds a meeting. <Amended Feb. 26, 2000; Aug. 30, 2000; Feb. 21, 2005>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항에 따른 의사록은 국세청장이 국세청소속공무원중에서 임명하는 간사가 이를 작성하며, 다음 각 호의 사항을 기재해야 한다. <개정 2000. 8. 30., 2021. 10. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The minutes pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be prepared by a secretary appointed by the Commissioner of the National Tax Service from among the officials of the National Tax Service, and shall record the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Aug. 30, 2000; Oct. 28, 2021>
1. Date and Time of the Meeting and Location
2. Names of attending members
3. Matters to be submitted to the meeting
4. Matters for Resolution

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(경력증명서의 발급신청) 「세무사법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제1조의5제4항의 규정에 의한 경력증명서의 발급신청은 별지 제1호서식에 의한다. <개정 2005. 2. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Application for Issuance of Certificate of Career) An application for issuance of a certificate of career pursuant to Article 1-5(4) of the Enforcement Decree of the Certified Tax Accountant Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be made using Attached Form No. 1.
[This Article was newly established on Aug. 30, 2000.]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(응시원서) ① 법 제5조에 따른 세무사자격시험(이하 “시험”이라 한다)에 응시하려는 자는 별지 제2호서식의 응시원서를 영 제34조의2제2항에 따라 시험의 시행에 관한 업무를 위탁받은 기관의 장(이하 “시험시행기관장”이라 한다)에게 제출(정보통신망에 의한 제출을 포함한다)하여야 한다. <개정 2009. 4. 21., 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application Form) ①Any person who intends to take the Certified Tax Accountant Qualification Examination pursuant to Article 5 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Examination”) shall submit an application form in the format of Annex No. 2 to the head of the institution entrusted with the duties concerning the implementation of the Examination pursuant to Article 34-2, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “Head of the Examination Implementing Agency”) (including submission via information and communications network). <Amended Apr. 21, 2009; Mar. 10, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 규정에 의하여 제출된 서류는 이를 반환하지 아니한다.
rows.text_en: ② Documents submitted pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall not be returned.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(응시수수료) 영 제6조제1항에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 금액”이란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 금액을 말한다. <개정 1998. 2. 2., 2000. 2. 26., 2009. 4. 21., 2023. 7. 4., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Examination Fee) In Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “amount prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to the amount determined according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Feb. 2, 1998; Feb. 26, 2000; Apr. 21, 2009; Jul. 4, 2023; Jan. 2, 2026>
1. First Exam: 30,000 won
2. Second Exam: 30,000 won

rows.source_ko: 제5조(응시원서의 접수) ① 시험시행기관장은 제3조에 따라 응시원서를 접수하면 별지 제2호서식 하단의 세무사자격시험응시표를 교부하여야 한다. <개정 2009. 4. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Receipt of Application Forms) ① Upon receipt of an application form pursuant to Article 3, the head of the examination administering agency shall issue the Tax Accountant Qualification Examination Ticket at the bottom of Form No. 2. <Amended Apr. 21, 2009>
② Deleted <April 21, 2009>

rows.source_ko: ③시험시행기관장은 별지 제4호서식의 세무사자격시험응시자명부를 작성하여야 한다. <개정 2000. 8. 30., 2009. 4. 21.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the examination administering agency shall prepare the list of examinees for the Certified Tax Accountant qualification examination in accordance with Form No. 4. <Amended Aug. 30, 2000; Apr. 21, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(합격자명부등) ①시험시행기관장은 별지 제5호서식의 세무사자격시험합격자명부를 작성하여 합격자 발표일 7일전까지 재정경제부장관과 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 1998. 2. 2., 2000. 2. 26., 2000. 8. 30., 2009. 4. 21., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (List of Successful Candidates, etc.) ① The head of the examination administering agency shall prepare the list of successful candidates for the Certified Tax Accountant qualification examination in accordance with Form No. 5 attached hereto and submit it to the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Commissioner of the National Tax Service no later than 7 days prior to the announcement of successful candidates. <Amended Feb. 2, 1998; Feb. 26, 2000; Aug. 30, 2000; Apr. 21, 2009; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ② 시험시행기관장은 시험의 합격자에게 별지 제6호서식의 세무사자격시험합격통지서를 교부하고, 그 사실을 제1항에 따라 제출하는 세무사자격시험합격자명부에 적어야 한다. <개정 2009. 4. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of the examination administering agency shall issue a Notice of Passing the Certified Tax Accountant Qualification Examination in the form of Annex 6 to the successful candidates of the examination and record that fact in the list of successful candidates of the Certified Tax Accountant Qualification Examination submitted pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Amended Apr. 21, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(세무사자격증의 교부) ①영 제11조제2항의 규정에 의하여 세무사자격증을 교부받고자 하는 자는 별지 제7호서식의 세무사자격증교부신청서에 다음 각호에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 1994. 3. 25., 1998. 2. 2., 2000. 2. 26., 2000. 8. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Issuance of Certified Tax Accountant Qualification Certificate) ①person who wishes to be issued a Certified Tax Accountant qualification certificate pursuant to the provisions of Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service an application for the issuance of a Certified Tax Accountant qualification certificate in the form of Annex 7, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 25, 1994; Feb. 2, 1998; Feb. 26, 2000; Aug. 30, 2000>
1. Deleted <March 25, 1994>
2. Deleted <Aug. 30, 2000>

3.
One copy of the Certified Public Accountant (CPA) Certificate of Passing or the CPA Registration Certificate

4.
One copy of Attorney Registration Certificate

rows.source_ko: ②재정경제부장관은 제1항에 따라 세무사자격증의 교부신청을 한 자가 세무사의 자격이 있다고 확인될 때에는 별지 제8호서식의 세무사자격증을 교부하여야 하며, 그 사실을 별지 제9호서식의 세무사자격증교부대장에 적어야 한다. <개정 1998. 2. 2., 2000. 2. 26., 2009. 4. 21., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Finance and Economy confirms that a person who has applied for the issuance of a tax accountant certificate pursuant to Paragraph 1 is qualified as a tax accountant , the Minister shall issue a tax accountant certificate in the form of Annex 8 and record that fact in the Tax Accountant Certificate Issuance Register in the form of Annex 9. <Amended Feb. 2, 1998; Feb. 26, 2000; Apr. 21, 2009; Jan. 2, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(세무사등록) ①영 제12조제2항에 따라 세무사등록을 하려는 사람은 별지 제10호서식의 세무사등록신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 한국세무사회의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 1994. 3. 25., 1998. 2. 2., 2000. 2. 26., 2000. 8. 30., 2004. 4. 10., 2011. 6. 30., 2017. 3. 10., 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Registration of Certified Tax Accountant) ①A person who intends to register as a certified tax accountant pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for registration as a certified tax accountant in the form of Annex No. 10, attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the head of the Korean Association of Certified Tax Accountants. <Amended Mar. 25, 1994; Feb. 2, 1998; Feb. 26, 2000; Aug. 30, 2000; Apr. 10, 2004; Jun. 30, 2011; Mar. 10, 2017; Mar. 20, 2019>
1. Deleted <March 25, 1994>
2. One copy of resume

rows.source_ko: 3. 실무교육수료증명서 1부(법 제12조의6제1항에 해당되는 사람 및 법률 제7032호 세무사법중개정법률 부칙 제4조의 적용을 받는 사람만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of the Certificate of Completion of Practical Training ( applicable only to persons falling under Article 12-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act and persons subject to Article 4 of the Addenda to Act No. 7032, the Act Amending the Certified Public Tax Accountant Act )
4. Two photos (3.5 cm × 4.5 cm)

rows.source_ko: ②영 제12조제4항 및 제12조의2제2항에 따른 세무사등록증은 별지 제11호서식과 같다. <개정 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: ② The Certified Tax Accountant Registration Certificate pursuant to Article 12 , Paragraph 4 and Article 12-2 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 11. <Amended Mar. 20, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(세무사등록의 갱신) 영 제12조의2제1항에 따라 세무사등록을 갱신하려는 사람은 별지 제12호서식의 세무사등록갱신신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 한국세무사회의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 1998. 2. 2., 2000. 2. 26., 2000. 8. 30., 2011. 6. 30., 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Renewal of Tax Accountant Registration) A person who intends to renew their tax accountant registration pursuant to Article 12-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for renewal of tax accountant registration in the form of Annex No. 12, attached with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the head of the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants. <Amended Feb. 2, 1998; Feb. 26, 2000; Aug. 30, 2000; Jun. 30, 2011; Mar. 10, 2017>
1. Tax Accountant Registration Certificate
2. Deleted <March 25, 1994>
3. One copy of the membership certificate from the affiliated association
4. One photograph (3.5cm × 4.5cm)

rows.source_ko: 제10조(세무사등록부) ① 영 제13조제1항제4호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Register of Certified Tax Accountants) ① The terms “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” in Article 13, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as follows: <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>
1. Reason for qualification and date of certificate issuance
2. Education and Work Experience
3. Registration Date and Renewal Registration Date
4. Other matters

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제13조제2항에 따른 세무사등록부는 별지 제13호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The tax accountant registration book pursuant to Article 13 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 13 of the Attached Form .
[Wholly Amended Mar. 20, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제11조(등록사항변경신고) 영 제14조의 규정에 의한 세무사등록사항변경신고는 별지 제14호서식의 신고서에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Notification of Change in Registration Details) The notification of change in tax accountant registration details pursuant to the provisions of Article 14 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with the notification form in Annex No. 14 .

rows.source_ko: 제12조(세무사의 실무교육) ①법 제12조의6제1항에 따른 실무교육(이하 “실무교육”이라 한다)은 한국세무사회에서 실시한다. <개정 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Practical Training for Certified Tax Accountants) ① The practical training pursuant to Article 12-6, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “practical training”) shall be conducted by the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants. <Amended Mar. 10, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ②실무교육의 기간은 6월로 한다. 다만, 법 제5조의2의 규정에 의하여 세무사자격시험에 합격한 자와 법률 제7032호 세무사법중개정법률 부칙 제4조의 적용을 받는 자에 대하여는 그 실무교육기간을 1월로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The period of practical training shall be six months. However, for persons who have passed the tax accountant qualification examination pursuant to the provisions of Article 5-2 of the Act and persons subject to Article 4 of the Addenda to Act No. 7032, the Tax Accountant Act Amendment, the period of practical training shall be one month.

rows.source_ko: ③실무교육의 횟수ㆍ시기ㆍ내용 등은 한국세무사회의 장이 국세청장의 승인을 얻어 정한다. <개정 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants shall determine the frequency, timing, content, etc. of practical training upon obtaining the approval of the Commissioner of the National Tax Service. <Amended Mar. 10, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ④한국세무사회의 장은 실무교육실시 30일전까지 그 사실을 일간신문에 공고하여야 한다. 다만, 제2항 단서에 해당하는 자에 대하여는 1년간의 실무교육 실시계획을 국세청 또는 한국세무사회의 홈페이지에 게시하는 것으로 공고에 갈음할 수 있다. <개정 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: ④ The head of the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants shall announce the fact in a daily newspaper at least 30 days prior to the implementation of practical training. However, for persons falling under the proviso of Paragraph 2, posting the one-year practical training implementation plan on the website of the National Tax Service or the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants may substitute for the announcement. <Amended Mar. 10, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑤실무교육을 받고자 하는 자는 교육실시 10일전까지 한국세무사회의 장에게 신청하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Any person who wishes to receive practical training shall apply to the head of the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants at least 10 days prior to the commencement of the training. <Amended Mar. 10, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑥제2항 단서의 규정을 적용받는 실무교육의 신청자가 30인 미만인 경우에는 그 실무교육의 실시시기를 다음 분기 또는 반기까지 연기할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ If the number of applicants for practical training subject to the provisions of the proviso of Paragraph 2 is less than 30, the timing of the practical training may be postponed until the next quarter or half-year.

rows.source_ko: ⑦한국세무사회의 장은 실무교육 종료후 지체없이 실무교육수료자 명단을 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The head of the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants shall submit the list of those who have completed the practical training to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service without delay after the completion of the practical training. <Amended Mar. 10, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Apr. 10, 2004]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(업무실적 내역서) 영 제14조의2제1항에 따른 업무실적 내역서는 별지 제14호의2서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Statement of Business Performance) The statement of business performance pursuant to Article 14-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 14-2 .
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 20, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의2(세무법인등록신청서) 영 제14조의6제1항에 따른 세무법인 등록신청서는 별지 제14호의3서식과 같다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2024. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-2 (Application for Registration of Tax Firm) The application for registration of a tax firm pursuant to Article 14-6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 14-3 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 22, 2024>
[This Article was newly established on March 5, 2003.]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의3(세무법인등록부 등) ①영 제14조의6제2항에 따른 세무법인등록부는 별지 제14호의4서식과 같다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2024. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-3 (Register of Tax Firms, etc.) ①The Register of Tax Firms pursuant to Article 14-6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 14-4 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 22, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ②영 제14조의6제3항에 따른 세무법인등록증은 별지 제14호의5서식과 같다. <개정 2019. 3. 20., 2024. 3. 22.>
rows.text_en: ② The Certificate of Registration of a Tax Accounting Firm pursuant to Article 14-6 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 14-5 . <Amended Mar. 20, 2019; Mar. 22, 2024>
[This Article was newly established on March 5, 2003.]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의4(세무법인 해산사유의 통보) 법 제16조의13제2항의 규정에 의하여 세무법인이 해산사유 발생사실을 통보하고자 하는 경우에는 별지 제14호의6서식의 통보서에 다음 각호의 서류를 첨부하여 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 3. 10., 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-4 (Notification of Grounds for Dissolution of a Tax Firm) In cases where a tax firm intends to notify the occurrence of grounds for dissolution pursuant to the provisions of Article 16-13, Paragraph 2 of the Act , it shall submit a notification form in Annex 14-6, attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service. <Amended Mar. 10, 2017; Mar. 20, 2019>
1. One copy of the minutes of the general meeting of members

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제16조의13제3항에 따라 한국세무사회에 손해배상준비금을 예치한 사실을 증명하는 서류 1부(합병의 사유로 해산하는 경우를 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of the document proving the fact that a reserve for damages has been deposited with the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants pursuant to Article 16-13, Paragraph 3 of the Act (excluding cases of dissolution due to merger)
[This Article was newly established on March 5, 2003.]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의5(세무법인의 정관변경신고) 법 제16조의14에 따라 세무법인이 정관변경을 신고하려는 경우에는 별지 제14호의7서식의 신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 국세청장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 신고법인의 법인 등기사항증명서를 확인하여야 한다. <개정 2006. 7. 5., 2009. 4. 21., 2010. 7. 23., 2019. 3. 20.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-5 (Reporting of Amendment to Articles of Incorporation of a Tax Firm) In accordance with Article 16-14 of the Act , if a tax firm intends to report an amendment to its articles of incorporation, it shall submit a report in the form of Annex 14-7 to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. In this case, the Commissioner of the National Tax Service shall verify the certificate of corporate registration of the reporting firm through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . <Amended July 5, 2006; April 21, 2009; July 23, 2010; March 20, 2019>
1. One copy each of the new and old Articles of Association
2. Deleted <July 5, 2006>
3. One copy of the minutes of the general meeting of members
[This Article was newly established on March 5, 2003.]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(징계요구) 재정경제부장관 또는 국세청장과 한국세무사회의 장, 한국공인회계사회의 장, 대한변호사협회의 장은 영 제17조에 따라 세무사의 징계를 요구할 때에는 별지 제15호서식의 세무사 징계요구서에 증거서류를 첨부하여 영 제15조에 따른 세무사징계위원회에 제출해야 한다. <개정 1998. 2. 2., 2000. 2. 26., 2009. 4. 21., 2010. 7. 23., 2017. 3. 10., 2024. 3. 22., 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Request for Disciplinary Action) When the Minister of Finance and Economy or the Commissioner of the National Tax Service, the President of the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants, the President of the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants, or the President of the Korean Bar Association request disciplinary action against a certified public tax accountant pursuant to Article 17 of the Enforcement Decree , they shall submit a Request for Disciplinary Action against a Certified Public Tax Accountant in the form of Annex No. 15, accompanied by evidentiary documents, to the Certified Public Tax Accountant Disciplinary Committee pursuant to Article 15 of the Enforcement Decree. < Amended Feb. 2 , 1998; Feb. 26, 2000; Apr. 21, 2009; Jul. 23, 2010; Mar. 10, 2017; Mar. 22, 2024; Jan. 2, 2026>
Article 15 Deleted <Mar. 9, 2012>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(징계의결의 통보) 영 제22조의 규정에 의한 징계의결의 통보는 별지 제16호서식의 통지서에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Notification of Disciplinary Resolution) Notification of a disciplinary resolution pursuant to the provisions of Article 22 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of the notice in Annex No. 16 .

rows.source_ko: 제17조(외국세무자문사 자격승인 신청서 등) ① 법 제19조의3에 따라 외국세무자문사의 자격승인을 받으려는 사람은 별지 제16호의2서식의 자격승인 신청서에 법 제19조의3제2항 각 호에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Application for Approval of Qualification of Foreign Tax Advisor, etc.) ①A person who intends to obtain approval of qualification as a foreign tax advisor pursuant to Article 19-3 of the Act shall submit to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service an application for approval of qualification in Form No. 16-2 of the Appendix , attaching the documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 19-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제19조의3제2항제3호에 따른 서약서는 별지 제16호의3서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The pledge form pursuant to Article 19-3, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Act is as shown in Form No. 16-3 of the Attached Form .
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조의2(외국세무자문사 자격증 등) ① 법 제19조의4제1항에 따른 외국세무자문사 자격증은 별지 제16호의4서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 17-2 (Foreign Tax Advisor Qualification Certificate, etc.) ①The foreign tax advisor qualification certificate pursuant to Article 19-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 16-4 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 국세청장은 법 제19조의4제1항에 따라 외국세무자문사 자격증을 발급한 때에는 그 사실을 별지 제16호의5서식의 외국세무자문사 자격증 발급대장에 적어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Commissioner of the National Tax Service issues a foreign tax advisor certificate pursuant to Article 19-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he /she shall record that fact in the foreign tax advisor certificate issuance register in Form No. 16-5 of the Attached Register.
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조의3(외국세무자문사의 등록) ① 영 제30조의4제1항에 따라 외국세무자문사의 등록을 하려는 사람은 별지 제16호의6서식의 외국세무자문사 등록신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: Article 17-3 (Registration of Foreign Tax Advisors) ①Any person who intends to register as a foreign tax advisor pursuant to Article 30-4, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service an application for registration of a foreign tax advisor in the form of Annex 16-6, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 10, 2017>
1. One copy of resume
2. Two photos (3.5cm × 4.5cm)

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제30조의4제3항에 따른 외국세무자문사등록증은 별지 제16호의7서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The foreign tax advisor registration certificate pursuant to Article 30-4, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree is in the form of Annex 16-7 .
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조의4(외국세무자문사등록의 갱신) 영 제30조의5제1항에 따라 외국세무자문사등록을 갱신하려는 사람은 별지 제16호의8서식의 외국세무자문사 등록갱신신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: Article 17-4 (Renewal of Registration of Foreign Tax Advisors) A person who intends to renew the registration of a foreign tax advisor pursuant to Article 30-5, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service an application for renewal of registration of a foreign tax advisor in the form of Annex 16-8, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 10, 2017>
1. Foreign Tax Advisor Registration Certificate
2. One copy of the membership certificate from the affiliated association
3. 1 passport-sized photo
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조의5(외국세무자문사등록부) 영 제30조의6에 따른 외국세무자문사등록부는 별지 제16호의9서식과 같다
rows.text_en: Article 17-5 (Register of Foreign Tax Advisors) The Register of Foreign Tax Advisors pursuant to Article 30-6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 16-9 of the Attached Form.
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조의6(외국세무자문사의 등록사항 변경신고) 영 제30조의7에 따른 외국세무자문사 등록사항 변경신고를 하려는 사람은 별지 제16호의10서식의 등록사항 변경신고서를 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17-6 (Notification of Change in Registration Details of Foreign Tax Advisors) Any person who intends to report a change in registration details of a foreign tax advisor pursuant to Article 30-7 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit a report on the change in registration details in Form No. 16-10 of the Attached Form to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service.
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조의7(법인 외국세무자문사무소 등록신청) ① 영 제30조의10제1항에 따른 등록신청서는 별지 제16호의11서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 17-7 (Application for Registration of Foreign Corporate Tax Advisory Office) ①The application for registration pursuant to Article 30-10, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 16-11 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제30조의10제1항제5호에서 “재정경제부령으로 정하는 서류”란 사무소의 설치예정지가 적힌 서류 1부를 말한다. <개정 2026. 1. 2.>
rows.text_en: ② In Subparagraph 5 of Article 30-10, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “documents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Finance and Economy” refers to one copy of a document specifying the planned location for the establishment of an office. <Amended Jan. 2, 2026>
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조의8(법인 외국세무자문사무소등록부 등) ① 영 제30조의10제2항에 따른 법인 외국세무자문사무소등록부는 별지 제16호의12서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 17-8 (Register of Foreign Corporate Tax Advisory Offices, etc.) ①The Register of Foreign Corporate Tax Advisory Offices pursuant to Article 30-10, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 16-12 .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제30조의10제3항에 따른 법인 외국세무자문사무소등록증은 별지 제16호의13서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The Certificate of Registration of a Foreign Tax Consulting Office for Corporations pursuant to Article 30-10 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 16-13 .
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]

rows.source_ko: 제17조의9(법인 외국세무자문사무소의 등록사항 변경신고) 영 제30조의11에 따라 법인 외국세무자문사무소 등록사항 변경신고를 하려는 자는 별지 제16호의14서식의 등록사항 변경신고서를 국세청장에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17-9 (Notification of Change in Registration Details of a Corporate Foreign Tax Advisory Office) Any person who intends to report a change in registration details of a corporate foreign tax advisory office pursuant to Article 30-11 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit a report on the change in registration details in Form No. 16-14 of the Attached Form to the Commissioner of the National Tax Service.
[This Article was newly established on June 30, 2011.]
Article 18 Deleted <Mar. 10, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제19조(세무대리업무등록 등) ①영 제33조의5에 따라 세무대리업무등록 등을 하려는 사람에 대하여는 제8조부터 제11조까지의 규정을 준용한다. 이 경우 “세무사등록”은 “세무대리업무등록”으로, “세무사등록신청서”는 “세무대리업무등록신청서”로, “한국세무사회의 장”은 “국세청장”으로, “세무사등록갱신신청서”는 “세무대리업무등록갱신신청서”로, “세무사등록부”는 “세무대리업무등록부”로, “세무사등록사항변경신고”는 “세무대리업무등록사항변경신고”로 본다. <개정 2011. 6. 30., 2017. 3. 10.>
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Registration of Tax Agency Business, etc.) ① The provisions of Articles 8 through 11 shall apply mutatis mutandis to persons who intend to register, etc. for tax agency business pursuant to Article 33-5 of the Enforcement Decree . In this case, “tax accountant registration” shall be deemed “registration of tax agency business,” “application for tax accountant registration” shall be deemed “application for registration of tax agency business,” “President of the Korean Association of Certified Public Tax Accountants” shall be deemed “Commissioner of the National Tax Service,” “application for renewal of tax accountant registration” shall be deemed “application for renewal of tax agency business registration,” “tax accountant register” shall be deemed “tax agency business register,” and “notification of change of tax accountant registration details” shall be deemed “notification of change of tax agency business registration details.” <Amended June 30, 2011; March 10, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ②영 제33조의5의 규정에 의한 세무대리업무등록증은 별지 제18호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The tax agency business registration certificate pursuant to the provisions of Article 33-5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 18 .
[This Article was newly established on April 10, 2004.]
Article 20 Deleted <April 7, 2020>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance Decree No. 1826, May 31, 1990>

rows.source_ko: ①(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: ① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: ②(실무교육에 관한 적용례) 제12조의 개정규정은 1990년 1월 1일 이후 시행되는 세무사자격시험 또는 공인회계사자격시험에 합격한 자와 1989년도에 시행된 공인회계사 제2차시험에 합격한 자에 대하여 이를 적용한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Applicability to practical training) The amended provisions of Article 12 shall apply to those who have passed the Certified Tax Accountant qualification examination or the Certified Public Accountant qualification examination administered on or after January 1, 1990, and to those who have passed the second stage of the Certified Public Accountant examination administered in 1989.

rows.source_ko: ③(개정서식에 관한 경과조치) 별지 제17호의 개정서식을 1991년 1월 1일 이후 세무대리를 위촉받는 것부터 사용한다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Transitional measures concerning the revised form) The revised form in Annex No. 17 shall be used for tax agency appointments received on or after January 1, 1991.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance Decree No. 1969, Mar. 25, 1994>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Prime Minister's Decree No. 681, Feb. 2, 1998>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance and Economy Decree No. 123, Feb. 26, 2000>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance and Economy Decree No. 163, Aug. 30, 2000>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제7조제1항제2호 및 별지 제7호서식 앞면의 구비서류란 제1호의 개정규정은 2001년 1월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 7, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 and Subparagraph 1 of the required documents section on the front of Form No. 7 shall enter into force on January 1, 2001.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance and Economy Decree No. 303, Mar. 5, 2003>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2003년 3월 31일부터 시행한다. 다만 별지 제7호서식의 개정규정은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on March 31, 2003. However, the amended provisions of Form No. 7 shall enter into force on the date of promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance and Economy Decree No. 378, Apr. 10, 2004>

rows.source_ko: ①(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: ① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: ②(합격증서에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 종전의 규정에 의하여 재정경제부장관으로부터 교부받은 세무사자격시험합격증서는 제6조의 개정규정에 의하여 세무사자격심의위원회의 위원장으로부터 교부받은 세무사자격시험합격통지서로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional measures concerning certificates of passing) A certificate of passing the tax accountant qualification examination issued by the Minister of Finance and Economy pursuant to the former regulations at the time of the enforcement of this rule shall be deemed to be a notice of passing the tax accountant qualification examination issued by the Chairperson of the Tax Accountant Qualification Deliberation Committee pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 6.

rows.source_ko: ③(세무사자격시험 면제자의 실무교육에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행전에 세무사회의 장이 종전의 제12조제2항 및 제4항 내지 제6항의 규정을 준용하여 실시한 실무교육을 법 제5조의2의 규정에 의하여 세무사자격시험에 합격한 자와 법률 제7032호 세무사법중개정법률 부칙 제4조의 적용을 받는 자가 받은 경우에는 제12조의 개정규정에 의한 실무교육을 받은 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Transitional measures concerning practical training for persons exempted from the tax accountant qualification examination) In cases where practical training conducted by the head of the Association of Certified Tax Accountants prior to the enforcement of this Rule, in accordance with the provisions of the former Article 12, Paragraphs 2 and 4 through 6, has been received by persons who have passed the tax accountant qualification examination pursuant to Article 5-2 of the Act and persons subject to Article 4 of the Addenda to Act No. 7032, the Act Amending the Certified Tax Accountant Act, it shall be deemed that such persons have received practical training pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 12.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance and Economy Decree No. 415, Feb. 21, 2005>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <재정경제부령 제512호, 2006. 7. 5.> (행정정보의 공동이용 및 문서감축을 위한 국가를 당사자로 하는 계약에 관한 법률 시행규칙 등 일부개정령)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Finance and Economy Decree No. 512, July 5, 2006> (Partial Amendment to the Enforcement Rules of the Act on Contracts to Which the State is a Party, etc. for the Joint Use of Administrative Information and Document Reduction)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Strategy and Finance Decree No. 73, Apr. 21, 2009>

rows.source_ko: 이 영은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제4조의 개정규정은 2010년 1월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, the amended provisions of Article 4 shall enter into force on January 1, 2010.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Strategy and Finance Decree No. 162, July 23, 2010>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Strategy and Finance Decree No. 220, June 30, 2011>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 「대한민국과 유럽연합 및 그 회원국 간의 자유무역협정」이 발효하는 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제8조제1항, 제9조, 제19조제1항, 별지 제10호서식부터 별지 제12호서식까지 및 별지 제14호서식의 개정규정은 2011년 8월 3일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on the date the "Free Trade Agreement between the Republic of Korea and the European Union and its Member States" enters into force. However, the amended provisions of Article 8, Paragraph 1, Article 9, Article 19, Paragraph 1, Forms No. 10 through No. 12, and Form No. 14 shall enter into force on August 3, 2011.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Strategy and Finance Decree No. 275, Mar. 9, 2012>
